- **T2 always-on residue:** log-row construction 2-5 µs + needle arg-builds ~1 µs + flag-validation loop 10-15 µs + wrapper frames/debug dicts ~1.5 µs ≈ **15-22 µs/event [MEAS+EST]**
- **T1 runtime-branch residue:** ~50-60 env reads/event ≈ 11-13 µs + ~30 guarded no-op calls/try-frames/imports ≈ 3-5 µs + info_once ≈ 1-2 µs ≈ **15-20 µs/event [MEAS+EST]**
- **Instrument-era functional recompute (cacheable, not strictly exam):** 2× SPEC_CONFIG json.loads + 2× literal_eval+sorted ≈ 38 µs + reqkey churn ≈ 10 µs ≈ **~50 µs/event [MEAS+EST]**
- **Device/DtoH residue: ZERO** in live config (counter arg=None when METRICS=0; one packed DtoH is the functional EAGER_PACK transport; traceless bind already proved DtoH bytes 4,017,072→39,176 = 0.0098x with NO speed change — 0.999166x).

**TOTAL examination residue ≈ 30-45 µs/event python-only (≈80-95 µs counting hoistable recompute).**

**Verdict vs the gaps:** parked residual = 4-6.5 ms/fwd (1.019-1.030x of ~0.218 s/fwd) → residue = **0.5-1.1% of the residual (≤2% with recompute included) = noise-level, NOT a meaningful slice.** TPS framing: gap ≈ 3-9 ms/token; residue ≈ 10-15 µs/token ≈ 0.1-0.5%. **11k-ctx discriminator:** residue is constant/event while the 11k gap GROWS to 1.05-1.06x — a constant-python tax would dilute with context, so the growing ratio is intrinsic (long-KV decode kernel: pinned `num_warps=4/num_stages=3` unified-attention vs FA2's tuned path, qq-bias TREE_ATTN decode), not examination. This matches FR13_B1_SPEED_ATTRIBUTION_BIND's measured decomposition of the residual (graph-launch CPU 0.71 vs 0.29 ms/draft, eager-op storm ≈+8 ms GPU/draft second-order, tree-GDN net +1.7 ms, TREE_ATTN ≈+0.3) — the residual lives in kernels/launch shape, not in flag plumbing. Nothing has regressed since the traceless bind: launcher still defaults the 3 high-volume trace paths empty (fr13_launch_forked_fa2_tree_server.sh:94-96) and FR10_METRICS=0 (:13).

**Caveat (armed regimes):** any boot with FR10_METRICS=1, FR13_CHASE_DIAG=1, FR13_REPLAY_BOUNDARY_LOG=1, or FR13_EAGER_PACK=0 re-enters the legacy committer loop = **96 blocking `.item()` DtoH/event (:6131-6160) + per-row sha digests = ms-class** — diag boots are not speed-comparable (already policy, re-confirmed).

## 3) T0 conversion list (patcher omits block when flag unset AT PATCH TIME — env IS known: the patcher runs in-container at launch; precedent already in-tree at `_patch_triton_unified_attention_fr13` :10667 and the "FR12/13 hooks compiled out" arbiter language)

**Omit-when-unset (pure diag, no runtime A/B role):** all rows 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 13, 14, 15, 19, 20, 26, 27, 28, 29, 33 + FR10_TREE_GDN_CAPTURE_PAYLOAD/SRC_NATIVE_PAYLOAD/COMMIT_HANDOFF_LOG/ROOT_H0_LOG (:2674-2678, :3413-3518, :4185-4191, :4320), FR13_PREFILL_GDN_CAPTURE (:4721-4741), FR12_FULL_ATTN_CAPTURE (:11646+), FR13_FORCE_SPINE_COMMIT branch, the FR10_METRICS scheduler/caterpillar/mamba-copy/consumption writers, and row 18's log-row construction (move inside the gate). **Hoist-to-module-const (same T0 effect, no omission needed):** FR10_METRICS, FR10_ENABLE_TREE_GDN, FR10_ALLOW_LINEAR_FALLBACK, FR13_REPLAY_ROUTE, FR13_TREE_REQKEY, FR13_TREE_BONUS_SELF, FR13_TREE_PER_REQ_GEN, FR13_TREE_SAMPLE_ROW, FR13_TREE_REMAP_SEQ (pattern precedent: `_FR13_EAGER_PACK` :784/:5133, `_FR13_TREE_CONV_FUSED` :793). **Hoist-to-init:** SPEC_CONFIG json.loads+literal_eval (rows 23/24 — boot-constant topology), drafter choices lists (row 12). **Keep runtime (NOT T0-able):** row 21 flag validation (class-9 banned shortcut), one boot needle per instrument (class 9 "boot needles"), FR10_DECODE_MODE module-global handshake (functional), and the A/B arms FR13_DRAFTER_SINGLE_LOGITS / FR13_EAGER_PACK / FR13_TREE_CONV_FUSED legacy paths (already import-time consts ≈ zero cost; compiling the OFF arm out would force re-patch-per-arm A/B on different binaries).

**Ordering/capture risks of conversion:** (1) **Sentinel idempotence trap**: every `_patch_*` skips files already containing its sentinel — a container patched flags-OFF will NOT grow the blocks when a diag env is later exported → class-9 vacuous instrument; mitigation = bake the patch-time flag matrix into a sentinel header + boot fail-loud (env set but block compiled out ⇒ RuntimeError), and re-patch from pristine site-packages when the matrix differs. (2) **Producer/consumer pairing** (the bind's `:1283 _fr10_path0_x` caution — consumed at `:1481/:1625-1642` under METRICS=1): omit pairs together; the diagnostics-off byte gate cannot catch a broken METRICS=1 path — needs one METRICS=1 smoke boot after conversion. (3) **Graph-capture re-baseline**: changed module layout/allocation order shifts addresses → cross-boot byte-comparability of banked captures breaks (class 11); re-run the B=1 same-seed repeat gate (playbook gate 1) before trusting post-conversion numbers. (4) **FR13_EAGER_PACK default split found**: gdn_linear/committer default `"0"` (:784, :5133) vs runner sites default `"1"` (:7346, :7633) — launcher pins =1 so live is coherent, but a launcher-less boot splits committer (96 blocking readbacks) from runner (pinned caches); unify the default during conversion. (5) Lost capture-time fail-louds (boundary/chase raise-on-capture) go away with their blocks — flag-state headers must move to the launcher banner. **Expected reclaim: ~0.03-0.1 ms/event ≈ 1-2.5% of the parked residual — hygiene, not the explanation; the residual is intrinsic tree cost (graph-launch shape + eager-op storm + long-KV attention kernel), per the nsys-measured attribution bind.**

Numbers (gold-gate SWE windows, rederived from gold_compare_reduce.json): tree 0.2480/0.2506 s/fwd vs native 0.2364/0.2374 → gap 11-14 ms/fwd. Total OFF-path examination residue from the 36-surface census: T2 always-on (ungated log-row dict builds 2.1-5 µs [MEAS], EAGER_PACK 48-layer flag-validation 10-15 µs [EST], needle arg-builds + wrapper frames ~2.5 µs) ≈ 15-22 µs/event; T1 runtime-branch (~50-60 env reads at 210-222 ns [MEAS] + guarded no-op calls at 37 ns [MEAS]) ≈ 15-20 µs/event; hoistable instrument-era functional recompute (2x SPEC_CONFIG json.loads + 2x literal_eval+sorted = 18.2 µs each [MEAS], reqkey churn) ≈ 50 µs/event. Total ≈ 30-45 µs/event python-only, ≤80-95 µs with recompute = ≤0.1 ms/fwd ≈ 0.7-2.5% of the 11-14 ms gap, ≤0.02 TPS of the 1.1-3 TPS gap. Device/DtoH residue in the live config is ZERO (counter arg=None at METRICS=0; the 96x .item() legacy loop is bypassed by FR13_EAGER_PACK=1).

Error bars are honest because the upper bound is anchored by a MEASURED ceiling, not estimates: FR13_B1_TRACELESS_SPEED_BIND measured the FULL 3-writer payload (json.dumps + write, ~600B-3KB/event) at 0.00025 s/fwd (0.08%); the surviving residue is strictly smaller than that payload, so the bound ≤0.0003 s/fwd holds even if every [EST] is 3x low. Per-layer python inside gdn_linear_attn/qwen3_next/tree_attn does NOT execute at decode — the forward is FULL-CUDA-graph replayed (824 cudaGraphLaunch/68 drafts), so the 48-layer tap sites tax only capture/warmup.

The decisive discriminator: residue is CONSTANT per event, but the gap GROWS with context (1.019-1.030x at 64tok → 1.05-1.06x at 11k). A constant python tax would DILUTE as forwards lengthen; a growing ratio means the cost scales with the kernel work — long-KV unified-attention (pinned num_warps=4/num_stages=3 vs FA2 tuned path), the 10-row vs 6-row verify shape, graph-launch CPU (0.71 vs 0.29 ms/draft), per the nsys-measured FR13_B1_SPEED_ATTRIBUTION_BIND decomposition. The residual lives in kernels and launch shape, not flag plumbing.

FAIRNESS AUDIT: (1) Gold gate (16.8-18.3 vs 19.4-19.8 TPS) — FAIR. Zero server-side instrument bytes written in-window on BOTH arms (logs/ empty except a 147B boot sha256); proxy/stdout/metrics machinery identical in config and cadence class; native's larger pair-dumps (8.6 vs 6.6 MB) are throughput-proportional, not a tax. The only asymmetry is the tree arm's inert flag reads + ungated dict builds, bounded ≤0.12% — three orders below the 8-14% gap. (2) FIX-A/FIX-3 gates — MILDLY UNFAIR: their runners pin all three trace writers on every arm including 'clean' speed arms (run_fix3_arm.sh:49-51, run_fixA_arm.sh:63-65; measured 1.5-2.2 MB/window, masked on naive ls by snapshot_window truncation), compared against a traceless banked native ref (0.2182 s/fwd) → ratio inflation ≤~0.0015x. The quoted 1.030x is really ~1.029x. No verdict changes; the internal ON-vs-OFF A/Bs inside those gates were fair (both arms traced identically). (3) Nothing regressed since the Jun-11 traceless bind in the gold path — but the fix-gate runner templates re-introduced trace pinning and are a copy-paste hazard.

Expected reclaim: ~0.03-0.1 ms/event ≈ 1-2.5% of the parked residual. This is HYGIENE, not the explanation.
synthesis.remeasurePlan:
RE-MEASURE PLAN (after the profile lands; GPU stages serialized behind the gold gate, same protocols as the binds):

GATE 0 — numerics-neutrality (playbook gate 1, B=1 same-seed repeat, FIRST): boot production-clean tree, run the pinned 64-tok probes twice same-seed → bit-identical commit streams; then diff the argmax/commit stream against a pre-conversion HEAD-21d16462 tree boot on the same probes. The conversion touches zero device math, so ANY token divergence = conversion bug (likely allocation-order/layout shift) — STOP, do not record speed.

ARM SET (all with container_env.txt capture + logs/-empty assert + flag-matrix banner, per the gate-state audit method):
1. 64-tok pinned probes x3 arms: tree-clean (new patcher), tree-current (HEAD 21d16462 patcher, traceless env), native banked ref (E5 protocol, per-request s/fwd basis — never aggregate decode_seconds, FR10 pitfall). This isolates the conversion delta at the regime where the ratio is 1.019-1.030x.
2. 11k-ctx probes, tree-clean vs native — the context discriminator.
3. ONE SWE window pair (run_gold_arm.sh protocol, ~1565 s window, gold_compare_reduce.json swe_window_metrics_context reduction): tree-clean vs native, B=1, FULL-graph confirmed (PIECEWISE=1/FULL=1 banner + cudaGraphLaunch count needle).
4. One METRICS=1 smoke boot of tree-clean (NOT for speed) — verifies the surviving producer/consumer pairs (:1283 _fr10_path0_x ↔ :1481/:1625-1642) still work when armed; the diagnostics-off byte gate cannot catch a broken METRICS=1 path.

CONFIRM/REFUTE THRESHOLDS:
- Residue hypothesis CONFIRMED (census wrong) iff tree-clean gains >0.5 ms/fwd at 64tok (ratio 1.030→≤1.027) or >0.1 TPS in the SWE window, reproduced across both probe reps → escalate to an nsys recount per FR13_B1_SPEED_ATTRIBUTION_BIND to find the missed hot surface.
- Residue hypothesis REFUTED / intrinsic CONFIRMED (the prediction) iff deltas ≤0.3 ms/fwd and ≤0.02-0.05 TPS — i.e. the clean re-measure is a NULL result within run-to-run noise, and the 11k ratio stays 1.05-1.06x. Nothing in the census scales with context, so if the 11k ratio DROPS materially, something context-proportional was instrument-tied and the census missed it (not expected).
- Bonus: re-quote the FIX-3-style 64-tok ratios from arm 1 to retire the ≤0.0015x trace-pin inflation footnote on the banked 1.019-1.030x numbers.
Post-conversion, banked per-layer byte captures are NOT cross-boot comparable (layout shift, class 11) — re-baseline any byte-level reference before reuse.
synthesis.acceptInteraction:
CAN INSTRUMENTS PERTURB ACCEPT, NOT JUST SPEED? In the OFF state: NO plausible value channel. Every OFF-path surface is python-side env reads, branch skips, and CPU dict builds — zero device math, zero syncs, zero mutation of q/p/logits/state; accept at fixed values is deterministic, and python timing cannot reorder a FULL-CUDA-graph replay. Strongest evidence is the symmetry argument: tree_a and tree_b carried BYTE-IDENTICAL instrument state (verified container_env) yet show the accept spread (3.17 vs 3.59 accepted/draft) — so the spread CANNOT be instrument-caused; it is trajectory divergence (agentic SWE loops amplify any single early token difference into a different transcript) plus cross-boot nondeterminism (autotune/config flips, the L0c class).

Three REAL channels the accept-spread investigation must control, none of them 'examination' in the strict sense:
1. Unconditional device allocs at builder init (gdn_attn :300-301, 1xint32+32xfp32 counter/diag tensors, allocated even with METRICS=0) shift memory layout/addresses → can flip Triton autotune choices or nondeterministic-reduction orderings cross-boot (the L0c GEMM-drift class). The T0 conversion will shift layout AGAIN — hence Gate 0 same-seed repeat before trusting post-conversion accept stats. If accept-spread runs need cross-boot comparability, pin LUMO_BATCH_INVARIANT_VLLM=1 arms (accepting the speed penalty) for the accept-attribution leg only.
2. ON-state diag boots: TCF_SELFCHECK dual-path recompute, boundary taps, and the EAGER_PACK=0 legacy loop introduce device ops and blocking .item() syncs. Syncs don't change values, but they can MASK a latent missing-sync race — meaning diag-ON accept could differ from diag-OFF for a real bug reason. Never source accept statistics from a diag boot (already policy); the B=1 same-seed repeat on the CLEAN boot is the race detector.
3. Functional flags that LOOK like instruments but sit directly in the accept path: FR13_TREE_SAMPLE_ROW=1 (launcher default :13 area — changes the sample row after 51.2% of cat9 partial accepts, BY DESIGN, chain-neutral) and FR13_EAGER_PACK (transport of accepted tokens; the :784/:5133 vs :7346/:7633 default split means a launcher-less boot changes the committer readback path — values identical per the byte gate, but unify it anyway), FR13_TREE_CONV_FUSED arm choice. The accept-spread investigation must pin all three identically across arms and record them in the flag-state header; a runner that drops the launcher would silently flip SAMPLE_ROW/EAGER_PACK and change accept legitimately.
Also noted: the MTP_DRAFT_TRACE wrapper monkeypatches EagleProposer.propose unconditionally — pass-through, no value change, but it is an extra frame in the drafter path every event; the conversion removes the rebind when off, eliminating even that. Net: nothing currently armed in the gold protocol can move accept; the accept spread is a separate (nondeterminism + trajectory) investigation and the instrument census neither explains nor contaminates it.
synthesis.risks:
RISKS OF THE CONVERSION (and of believing the census):
1. SENTINEL IDEMPOTENCE TRAP (class-9 vacuous instrument): every _patch_* skips files already containing its sentinel — a container patched flags-OFF will NOT grow the diag blocks back when an env is later exported; the flag would read as set while the code is absent. Mitigation is mandatory, not optional: flag-matrix sentinel header + boot RuntimeError when env and compiled matrix disagree + re-patch from pristine site-packages on matrix change.
2. PRODUCER/CONSUMER PAIR BREAKAGE: omitted producers with surviving consumers (e.g. _fr10_path0_x produced :1283, consumed :1481/:1625-1642 under METRICS=1) crash only when armed; the diagnostics-off byte gate is blind to it. One METRICS=1 smoke boot is part of the re-measure plan.
3. GRAPH-CAPTURE / BYTE-BASELINE INVALIDATION (class 11): changed module layout and allocation order shift device addresses → banked per-layer byte captures and cross-boot byte comparisons break; CUDA-graph capture itself must be re-verified (capture succeeds, FULL=1, launch count unchanged). Gate 0 same-seed repeat is the tripwire.
4. LOST FAIL-LOUDS: omitted blocks carried capture-time raises; their fail-loud duty moves to the launcher banner + boot needles. Keep ONE boot needle per instrument family — silent-off is banned (class 9), and the row-21 all-layer engagement assert stays (representative-layer validation banned, failed safety twice).
5. A/B ARM DESTRUCTION: compiling out the OFF arms of FR13_DRAFTER_SINGLE_LOGITS/EAGER_PACK/TREE_CONV_FUSED would put future A/Bs on different binaries — keep them as import-time consts.
6. RUNNER-TEMPLATE CONTAGION: the fix-gate runners (run_fixA_arm.sh:63-65, run_fix3_arm.sh:49-51) pin high-volume trace writers into 'clean' arms and snapshot_window truncation hides the evidence (0-byte live logs); any future runner copied from them re-contaminates speed arms. Fix the templates now; gold runner is the clean template.
7. EXPECTATION RISK: the honest prediction is a NULL speed result (~0.03-0.1 ms/event reclaim, ≤2.5% of the residual). If anyone sells the conversion as the path to closing the 1.03x/1.06x gap, that is the census being wrong — the nsys-bound attribution says the residual is intrinsic (graph-launch shape, eager-op storm second-order, long-KV unified-attention kernel vs FA2). Budget the conversion as hygiene + future-measurement insurance, not as a speed fix.
8. ESTIMATE PROVENANCE: [MEAS] figures are host-CPU microbenchmarks (env read 210-222 ns, dict build 2.1 µs, literal_eval 18.2 µs); in-container scheduling could inflate them ~2x, still bounded by the measured 0.00025 s/fwd full-writer ceiling from FR13_B1_TRACELESS_SPEED_BIND, which the residue strictly underruns.
synthesis.summary: Examination residue accounts for 0.5-2.5% of the tree's residual slowness; ≥97% is intrinsic. The 36-surface census sums OFF-path cost to 30-95 µs/event (≤0.1 ms/fwd) against an 11-14 ms/fwd gap, with a MEASURED ceiling (traceless bind: full 3-writer payload = 0.00025 s/fwd) that the surviving residue strictly underruns; device/DtoH residue is zero in the live config, and the per-layer tap sites are baked out of FULL-CUDA-graph decode entirely. The context discriminator is decisive: residue is constant/event but the gap GROWS 1.03x→1.06x at 11k ctx, so the residual lives in kernels/launch shape (long-KV unified-attention vs FA2, 10-row verify, graph-launch CPU) per the nsys attribution bind. Fairness: the gold-gate TPS comparison (16.8-18.3 vs 19.4-19.8) is fair — zero instrument bytes written in-window on both arms; the FIX-A/FIX-3 quoted ratios were inflated ≤0.0015x by trace writers pinned into their 'clean' tree arms vs a traceless native ref (1.030x → ~1.029x; no verdict changes), and those runner templates are a contagion hazard to fix. The production-clean profile (patch-time block omission per the 'hooks compiled out' precedent, gating the ungated log-row builds at :5501/:6478, env-read hoists, SPEC_CONFIG parse-once, EAGER_PACK default unification; ~150-250 lines in the patcher) reclaims ~0.03-0.1 ms/event — hygiene, expected NULL on re-measure (confirm: ≤0.3 ms/fwd delta; refute census: >0.5 ms/fwd or >0.1 TPS gain → nsys recount). Conversion requires the class-9 fail-loud flag-matrix sentinel, a METRICS=1 smoke boot, and a B=1 same-seed re-baseline (layout shift breaks banked byte captures). Accept interaction: OFF instruments cannot move accept (no device math, no syncs; tree_a/tree_b symmetry proves the accept spread is trajectory/nondeterminism, not instruments); the real accept-path controls are FR13_TREE_SAMPLE_ROW, FR13_EAGER_PACK default split, and builder alloc-order/autotune layout shifts.
